query: 2026 Florida Republican gubernatorial primary status: Byron Donalds candidacy, opponents, Trump endorsement, polling, competitors dropping out. Who is running against Donalds and what are the polls showing as of mid-2026?
answer:
The research is complete. Key finding that changes the framing of the question: **the primary already happened** — Byron Donalds won it on August 18, 2026, the day before this research.

**Short version:**
- **Result:** Donalds 47.8%, Jay Collins 25.2%, James Fishback 10.5%, Paul Renner 8.5%, seven others below 5%. Called by AP/CNN/NBC at poll close.
- **Who ran against him:** Lt. Gov. Jay Collins (entered Jan 2026), investor/online figure James Fishback (Nov 2025), ex-House Speaker Paul Renner (Sept 2025). None dropped out.
- **Trump endorsement:** February 20, 2025 — five days *before* Donalds announced. (NBC's post-primary piece says "May"; the archived Truth Social post and six contemporaneous outlets say February. I flagged the discrepancy.)
- **Polling:** averages had Donalds at 45–49% and were nearly perfect on him. What every aggregator missed was **Collins**, who finished at 25.2% against a polled 11–14%. The one poll showing a competitive race (TPSI, Aug 11: Donalds 34 / Fishback 29.4) was badly wrong — Fishback landed at 10.5%.
- **Who never ran:** Casey DeSantis (deflated by Trump's endorsement plus the Hope Florida controversy; never opened a campaign account), Matt Gaetz, Francis Suarez, Wilton Simpson, Ashley Moody. DeSantis endorsed no one.
- **Money:** Donalds >$111M vs. ~$18M for all three rivals combined.
- **General election:** vs. David Jolly. Polling average R+6; Sabato moved it Safe R → Likely R in July; Cook still Solid R; markets 83% R.

key_facts: The 2026 Florida Republican gubernatorial primary was held August 18, 2026. Byron Donalds WON it, called by AP/CNN/NBC shortly after 8:00 p.m. ET at poll close.
Donalds took 47.8% (810,552 votes); Lt. Gov. Jay Collins 25.2% (426,696); James Fishback 10.5% (177,660); Paul Renner 8.5% (144,950). Eleven Republicans were on the ballot. Margin: Donalds +22.6.
Results are preliminary and unofficial pending canvassing-board certification of provisional ballots and cure affidavits.
Donalds faces Democrat David Jolly (won Dem primary with ~62%) in the November 3, 2026 general election to succeed term-limited Ron DeSantis.

Trump endorsed Donalds on February 20, 2025 via Truth Social ('should he decide to run, will have my Complete and Total Endorsement. RUN, BYRON, RUN!') — five days BEFORE Donalds announced on February 25, 2025. NBC's post-primary claim of a 'May' endorsement conflicts with the contemporaneous record.
Three serious challengers, none of whom dropped out: Jay Collins (entered Jan 12, 2026), James Fishback (entered Nov 24, 2025), Paul Renner (entered Sept 3, 2025).

Casey DeSantis never entered the race. Her trial balloon (Feb 2025) was deflated by Trump's endorsement of Donalds plus the Hope Florida Medicaid-funds controversy; she never opened a campaign account or fundraised.
Other declined Republicans: Matt Gaetz, Francis Suarez, Wilton Simpson (endorsed Donalds), Ashley Moody (appointed to U.S. Senate instead).
Bill Reicherter withdrew. Five candidates failed to qualify: Charles Burkett (now running NPA in the general), Shea Cruel, Jenny Curtman, Daniel Imperato, John Mercadante.

Ron DeSantis never endorsed anyone in the primary — reportedly lobbied by megadonor Ken Griffin to stay on the sidelines. He called Renner 'really good' in the final weeks but stopped short of an endorsement.
Polling averages heading into Election Day: RealClearPolling had Donalds 48.7% (+37.5); 270toWin 47.5%; FiftyPlusOne 45.7%; Tampa Bay Times/NYT ~+40.
Polling nailed Donalds' topline (48.7 avg vs 47.8 actual) but badly missed the runner-up: Collins finished at 25.2% against a polling average of 11-14%, roughly doubling his polled support.
Fishback badly underperformed outlier polls: The Public Sentiment Institute (Aug 11) showed Donalds 34.0 / Fishback 29.4 — a 4.6-point race. Fishback finished at 10.5%.
Prediction markets before Election Day: Kalshi 98.4%, Polymarket 99% for Donalds to win the primary.
Donalds raised >$111 million (>$99M via the Friends of Byron Donalds PAC), with ~$58M cash on hand heading into the general. His three rivals raised just under $18M combined — a >6:1 disadvantage.
Ken Griffin (Citadel) gave $10M to Donalds' PAC; Sports Betting Alliance gave $1M in the final filing period.
Jolly has raised ~$10.2M with ~$3.75M cash on hand (including ~$1.3M state matching funds) — under a tenth of Donalds' operation.

Sabato's Crystal Ball moved Florida governor from Safe Republican to Likely Republican on July 23, 2026, citing the UNF poll (Donalds 46-41) and the open seat. Cook Political Report still rates it Solid Republican.
General election polling average (270toWin, 2 polls): Donalds 45.5%, Jolly 39.5% (R+6). Only Change Research (D-aligned, May) showed Jolly ahead (46-42); Edge/MDW (April) showed a 41-41 tie.
Post-primary prediction markets on the general: Kalshi 83% Republican, Polymarket 83% Republican.
